title: GiftFlow::sends matches a collection form's answer by PaymentsPurpose, so another ChangeGiftCollection request takes over the form's Sent(request)
trigger: With the New/Rename collection form open (Editing), a ChangeGiftCollection mutation from the gifts list (mutate_own_gifts -> flow_sent(purpose, extra)) is sent
effect: The form is marked Sent(other request) and closes on that unrelated answer, or stays 'sending' for a request it never made
fix: Pass the form's own RequestId into flow_sent from the form's submit path instead of matching by purpose

title: GiftMarketState::balance_low is a one-shot bool latch beside the notes/toasts queues
trigger: A paid gift request (buy, bid) is refused for too few Stars
effect: Today the UI drains it with mem::take and opens Stars; no bug, but the same event class (one-shot toast) lives in a Vec of strings and a bool, drained together by hand
fix: One Vec<MarketEvent> (Note(String), Toast{..}, BalanceLow) drained once

title: BadgeStage::Failed is pushed again on every sync_icon_badge pass with no backoff
trigger: Linux with no session bus or no listening dock, or Windows before the taskbar button exists, with the chrome loop running
effect: Each pass wakes the launcher worker, which retries Connection::session() and answers Failed again; wasted work for as long as the bus is missing
fix: Failed carries a retry-after deadline (or retries only on a wake poke from a tray/dock event)

title: Picker stages named by a request (VenueBot::Resolving, AskStage::InFlight, TileState::Requested) are never reconciled with the pending-request registry while the picker is open
trigger: Open Send Location, then a TDLib reconnect or client restart drops the venue-bot lookup, venue query or tile request without an error update
effect: Venue list stays Loading, or the map tile stays blank (Requested is never retried; move_ended only clears Failed) until the picker is closed and reopened
fix: A forget_dropped(pending) sweep like MessageEffects::forget_dropped, run after each ingest in pump_location_picker

title: MediaViewer 'open' is items.is_empty() and total only means something for SharedMedia/Profile sources
trigger: Open the viewer from the chat, from Shared Media, from a profile gallery
effect: Works today: open_* set source and total together; position() and wants_older() must re-check source by hand
fix: enum MediaViewerSource carrying total (Chat, Shared{total}, Profile{owner,total}, Poll) and an explicit Closed

title: NewChatStage::Creating keeps a RequestId and a CreateProgress that is re-derived from the request registry on each poll
trigger: Create a group and watch it settle (settled_new_chat)
effect: Created/Refused/Lost are stored inside Creating although nothing is in flight; request stays as a stale key and progress is a cached copy of Session.requests/creations
fix: Lift Refused/Lost/Created to their own NewChatStage variants and drop request once answered

title: The QR box keeps three hand-rolled request counters (box_id+serial, FreeTicket serial, GiftsAsk serial) beside RequestId
trigger: Open the QR box, save a theme, request a free code and open the gifts panel
effect: No bug today: each answer is matched to the serial held in its stage. But each stage (ThemeStage::Saving { serial }, FreeUi::Requesting { serial }, GiftsStage::FirstAsking(GiftsAsk)) holds a counter value instead of the RequestId of its request, so a request the table drops is not tied to the stage that waits for it, and PeerQrData::saves and free_answers/save_answers are queues that nothing drains while no box is open.
fix: Hold the RequestId in each stage (Saving { request }, Requesting { request }, FirstAsking { request }) and settle the stage from the request table, so the box going away drops its answers with it

title: A getProxies that could not be sent has no retry for a background account, and FailedStale keeps the list busy
trigger: The first or a refetch getProxies fails to send (ConnectSendError::Native/InvalidRequest, e.g. the client is closing) for a background account or an account whose proxy box is never opened
effect: fetch_unsent() sets Failed or FailedStale. wanted() is false for both, and the only caller of fetch_proxies() is ui/proxy/mod.rs:126, the on-screen dialog open. A background account's sync_proxies_to() returns false for good: Failed leaves the list None, FailedStale keeps busy() true, so its proxy list never mirrors the app's. On screen, rotation and the system-proxy step plan nothing until the user opens the proxy list.
fix: A retry owned by the stage (ProxyFetch::Failed { at } retried after a backoff on the next ingest) instead of a stage only a dialog open can leave

title: A corrupt accounts.json whose quarantine rename fails is never marked unreadable, so the next save overwrites it and re-parses it every frame
trigger: accounts.json fails to parse and std::fs::rename to accounts.json.corrupt-<ts> fails (file locked by a scanner on Windows, read-only parent); then add_account/set_active_account/rename_account runs
effect: The Some(Err) arm of load_registry returns the default registry without note_read(path,false) or caching. save_registry only refuses for paths in UNREADABLE, so the first save replaces the corrupt-but-recoverable account list with [primary]. Until then every UI frame (active_account is read per frame) re-reads, re-parses, retries the rename and prints to stderr.
fix: On the quarantine failure arm call note_read(&path,false) (or keep a Corrupt{path} stage in LOADED) so saves refuse and the read is cached until the file's stamp changes

title: Every geometry report spawns a writer thread that queues behind the write lock, there is no 'a writer is running' stage
trigger: Drag or resize the main window on a slow or scanned disk (fsync tens of ms) while stage_window_state + save_staged_window_state run per move event
effect: One OS thread per call, each blocked on Saver::write and then finding the slot empty; a long drag piles up hundreds of parked threads and, if the spawn fails, the call is silently dropped (only the quit flush saves it)
fix: A Writer stage (Idle | Running) in Saver, as DeferredWriter has, so a call while Running only stages and the running writer re-reads the slot before it exits

title: ReviewItem::request is an Option<RequestId> used as an 'was it sent yet' flag, matched by is_none() plus the session id
trigger: Review the new-login alert: begin_login_review creates one ReviewItem per session with request None, then login_review_sent / login_review_unsent find the first item with request.is_none() and the same entry id
effect: No bug today (review_unconfirmed_sessions refuses empty entry lists and settles every item on send failure). The two stages of an item, 'to send' and 'in flight under this request', are one Option, so an item that is neither sent nor reported unsent (a new send path that returns early) keeps the review Reviewing with no way out
fix: enum ReviewItemStage { ToSend, InFlight(RequestId) } inside ReviewItem, so Reviewing cannot hold an item that has no stage transition left

title: ChatSummary::my_member and ::my_restriction are two own-membership fields that must change together, but set_member_status moves only the first
trigger: Viewer is Restricted in a supergroup (my_restriction = Restricted(until 0)); an admin lifts the restriction and TDLib's updateSupergroup says Member before (or without) the own updateChatMember; or the viewer leaves (optimistic set_member_status(Left)) and rejoins
effect: adopt_supergroup_status / set_member_status(Member|Left) rewrites my_member only, so ChatSummary::restriction() still returns the old Restricted record: SendRights::personal() keeps blocking the composer and attachments with 'The admins ... restricted you' until an updateChatMember arrives (session_members.rs:200 is the only place that resets both)
fix: One OwnMembership enum (Unknown | Other(status) | Restricted{restriction} | Administrator(rights)) so a status change replaces the restriction with it, as AdminRights already does

title: HangUp::engine_hang_up_due is a one-shot bool for the second stage of a hang-up, set by the reducer and taken by the driver
trigger: discardCall answers ok (apply_hang_up_ok sets the flag); the driver pump (connect/calls/mod.rs:459) takes it with mem::take on its next pass
effect: No bug today: the terminal updateCall path hangs the engine up through active_call_before, so a dropped flag is covered. But the stage 'TDLib took the hang-up' lives as a bool beside `request`, and a pump that does not run (driver gone, account off screen) leaves the engine call open with the flag set
fix: HangUp as an enum { Requested(RequestId), Accepted } (or an EngineHangUp::{Owed, Done} the pump settles), so the flag is a stage that has a way out
